premises: Powder-pack boriding can be applied to boride-based components to form a uniform, adherent boride-rich surface layer.
A boride-rich surface layer acts as a diffusion barrier against aluminum and oxygen in molten aluminum.
A diffusion barrier reduces chemical reaction and penetration, thereby improving corrosion resistance.
Untreated boride-based components lack such a protective barrier and thus corrode more in molten aluminum.
